evidence.text: Do effective-field-theory consistency, phenomenology or vacuum statistics require a hierarchically small type IIB flux superpotential, or can generic W0 of order 1–10 remain consistent after moduli stabilization?

destination.title: Empirical reach of string cosmology
destination.question: Which cosmological observations can discriminate particular string constructions, given scale separation, incomplete theoretical control and limited generic predictions?
destination.summary: Organizes empirical questions without claiming universal string predictions or updating historical observational constraints.

sources.title: Challenges for String Cosmology

evidence.text: Given incomplete knowledge of string theory, how reliably can string constructions describe the observed universe, and how much can cosmological observations constrain string theory itself?

sources.title: Strings, branes and cosmology: What can we hope to learn?

evidence.text: Despite decoupling between widely separated scales, what can precision cosmology teach about string theory, and what can microscopic consistency teach about viable cosmological models?

sources.title: String Inflation After Planck 2013

evidence.text: How do string-inflation models fare against Planck 2013 constraints on spectral tilt, primordial tensors, non-Gaussianity and dark radiation, and what does their theoretical control suggest about future tensor searches?

sources.title: Fitting string inflation to real cosmological data: The fiber inflation case

evidence.text: Which combinations of Fibre Inflation parameters fit the cosmological datasets used in this 2020 analysis, and what conditional bounds do those fits impose on underlying string coupling, compactification volume and discrete brane flux?

sources.title: Challenges for String Cosmology

evidence.text: Its central method is a critical audit of approximation domains, omitted interactions and fields, and theoretical errors. The recommended research program combines explicit moduli stabilization, naturalness analysis, heavy-field effects and well-founded expansions.

sources.title: String Inflation After Planck 2013

evidence.text: For single-field slow-roll models, the review uses n_s−1 = 2η−6ε and r = 16ε to connect effective scalar potentials to observables, then compares prediction ranges with WMAP and Planck constraints.

sources.title: Fitting string inflation to real cosmological data: The fiber inflation case

evidence.text: Use an approximate analytic horizon-exit/observable treatment because the exact e-fold relation is not analytically solvable. Series in the implementation are truncated at n=65; the authors report that increasing this cutoff changes parameters below their code's numerical sensitivity.

sources.title: Strings, branes and cosmology: What can we hope to learn?

evidence.text: The review compares low-energy inflationary classes, examines whether moduli-stabilizing potentials preserve slow roll, and distinguishes genuine CMB deviations from changes in how microscopic parameters determine an inflaton potential.

sources.title: Challenges for String Cosmology

evidence.text: For singularities it surveys exactly solvable Lorentzian-orbifold CFTs, string quantization in exact plane waves, resolved-background limits, and AdS/CFT descriptions. These are imported tools and results concerning special backgrounds.

sources.title: Challenges for String Cosmology

evidence.text: For low-curvature bounces, the review uses the FRW Einstein equations at vanishing expansion rate and positive acceleration to identify the necessary energy-condition violations, with a separate positive-curvature case.

sources.title: String Cosmology: A Review

evidence.text: How does string theory's ultraviolet structure inform spacelike singularities, inflationary model building, moduli dynamics and dark energy, and which resulting cosmological signals could constrain particular constructions?

sources.title: Lectures on string/brane cosmology

evidence.text: Can string and brane dynamics supply inflation or alternatives, explain primordial density perturbations, and address cosmological singularities? The lectures assess proposed mechanisms and their unresolved prerequisites.

sources.title: Is String Phenomenology an Oxymoron?

evidence.text: What has string phenomenology achieved, which implications could be observable, and how should concrete scenarios be assessed when generic predictions are few and experimental access to the string scale is limited?

sources.title: Dark Energy in String Theory

evidence.text: Can string theory explain the observed accelerating expansion through a vacuum, a rolling modulus, or a thermally displaced scalar, and which observations could distinguish these mechanisms?

sources.title: Snowmass White Paper: Cosmology at the Theory Frontier

evidence.text: How can cosmology acquire a microphysical UV and IR completion explaining acceleration, inflationary observables, and cosmic-horizon entropy? This Snowmass review surveys string constructions, cosmological EFT, holography, and model-dependent observational tests.

sources.title: The dangerous irrelevance of string theory

evidence.text: How does string theory participate in empirical cosmology through ultraviolet sensitivity, inflationary mechanisms, and effective-field-theory guidance for observational searches?

sources.title: Inflation and String Theory

evidence.text: How can inflation arise as a controlled low-energy consequence of string theory, and which cosmological observables can constrain its ultraviolet origin?

sources.title: Inflation in string theory confronts data

evidence.text: What did the 2015 CMB constraints imply for string inflation mechanisms, and which tensor, spectral-feature, non-Gaussianity and null-result searches could further constrain their microscopic physics?
